## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Running `make test` produces **0 warnings** (the 2 `DeprecationWarning: ... use of forkpty() may lead to deadlocks in the child` warnings from `pty.py` are no longer visible in pytest output)
- [ ] The warning suppression is **test-scoped only** — implemented via a `filterwarnings` entry in `pyproject.toml` (or `@pytest.mark.filterwarnings` on the affected tests in `tests/test_terminals.py`), not by modifying the `pty.fork()` call site in `src/decafclaw/terminals.py`
- [ ] The filter targets **only** this specific warning (message pattern matching `forkpty` or the exact deprecation text, module matching `pty`), not a blanket `DeprecationWarning` ignore
- [ ] The spawn code and its inline comment (`terminals.py:71-73`) documenting the deliberate decision remain **unchanged**
- [ ] All existing tests in `tests/test_terminals.py` continue to pass
